title: It's A Wonderful Life 2026
seo_title: It's A Wonderful Life 2026 Free Screening in Springfield
description: This is the annual free showing of the film It's A Wonderful Life, presented by Multipli Credit Union, with free hot chocolate while supplies last and free photo ops with Mr. & Mrs. Claus. It is a family-friendly event, and tickets must be reserved by phone at 417-863-9491 or in person at the Gillioz Box Office starting November 9 at 10am, with a limit of 4 per order. It takes place Sunday, December 13, 2026 at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E. in Springfield, MO, with doors at 1:00 PM and the movie at 2:00 PM.
